title: Blockaid: Binance hackers stole ~$2.5B, or 40% of the $6.3B haul, in a single Ethereum transaction using wallet permissions that cost just $15 to set up (Sidhartha Shukla/Bloomberg)
summary: Sidhartha Shukla / Bloomberg: Blockaid: Binance hackers stole ~$2.5B, or 40% of the $6.3B haul, in a single Ethereum transaction using wallet permissions that cost just $15 to set up — The hackers who stole $6.3 billion from Binance last week found a way to take 40% of the stolen cryptocurrency in one hit …
